Keldeo

Water Fighting

Unova · Generation 5 · Mythical Pokémon

Keldeo is a Water/Fighting-type Colt Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 48.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (129), with a base stat total of 580.
